data.name: Pitabas
data.long_meaning: Pitabas is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for 'Lord of the Wisdom'. It is a revered name for the divine deity who is the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. The name Pitabas is a combination of 'Pitamaha', which means 'Father of the Universe', and 'Bas', which means 'Wise'. Thus, Pitabas is a name that signifies the wisdom of the universe and the divine power that bestows knowledge upon us.
